name: How long does new-room construction take?

mainEntity.name: How long does new-room construction take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of new-room construction varies significantly based on factors like the room's size, complexity, material choices, and the need for specialized permits. A simple room addition might take 2-4 months, while more complex projects could extend to 6 months or longer. Unforeseen issues, weather delays, and inspection schedules can also impact the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: New-room construction duration depends on size, complexity, and permits, typically ranging from 2 to 6 months.
